result.note: Mostly political messaging; tested only the checkable facts on the BMC result, Mamata Banerjee's tenure and the states with assembly elections due in 2026.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements in the context of political developments in January 2026:
items: In the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) elections, the BJP won an outright majority of the corporation's 227 seats.
Mamata Banerjee has run West Bengal since 2011, winning three straight mandates.
Puducherry was among the places with assembly elections due within a few months.
questions.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 is wrong. The BJP won 89 of the BMC's 227 seats, a strong showing but short of a majority. Assembly elections were due in Assam, West Bengal, Puducherry, Tamil Nadu and Kerala, and Mamata Banerjee had governed West Bengal since 2011.
questions.source: Modi’s Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) is riding momentum after a strong showing in the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC), Mumbai’s powerful municipal body, where it won 89 of 227 seats.
